page: Microsoft Azure D32plds_v6 is a virtual server instance powered by a 32-core custom Microsoft ARM Neoverse-N2 CPU operating at 3.4 GHz. Built on arm64 architecture, this instance features 32 dedicated physical cores without hyperthreading, paired with 64 GB of memory (2 GB per vCPU) and a 128 MB L3 cache. It comes equipped with 1,890 GB of high-speed local NVMe SSD storage and runs under the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance includes hardware-accelerated AES cryptography but lacks x86-specific vector extensions like AVX-512.

In benchmark evaluations, the D32plds_v6 exhibits strong multi-core processing efficiency, earning top-quartile results in stress-ng multi-core tests and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression. Memory subsystem performance is notable, placing in the top 10 percent for large-block uncached read bandwidth at 450.77 GB/sec alongside a top-tier PassMark memory score. In application-focused metrics, the instance achieves high throughput in PassMark database operations, Redis SET operations at 61.98 million per second, and static web serving at 53.68 GB/sec. Software compilation performance using Clang also ranks in the top 25 percent.

Despite strong memory throughput and high multi-core performance, single-core CPU speeds and single-threaded Geekbench benchmarks score in the average percentile range. Additionally, large-scale LLM inference for 70B parameter models shows low prompt processing speeds at 4.66 tokens per second due to the lack of dedicated GPU acceleration and lower memory-to-core density. Given its 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, high memory bandwidth, and integrated 1,890 GB NVMe drive, the instance provides strong resource density for database workloads, web servers, software build pipelines, and containerized microservices.
description: Microsoft Azure D32plds_v6 is a high-density, ARM-based cloud server powered by a 32-core Microsoft Neoverse-N2 processor running at 3.4 GHz. Featuring 64 GB of system memory, 128 MB L3 cache, and 1,890 GB of integrated local NVMe SSD storage, this instance delivers high parallel throughput for compute-focused workloads. In performance testing, the instance exhibits top-tier uncached memory read bandwidth at 450.77 GB/sec and PassMark database throughput, alongside top-quartile results in multi-core processing, Clang software compilation, and Redis SET operations. However, single-core speeds remain average, and execution of large-parameter LLM inference is limited without hardware accelerators. The 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and low-latency storage array make the D32plds_v6 well-suited for database management systems, static web serving, software build pipelines, and high-concurrency microservice architectures where sustained thread density and fast storage IO are primary requirements.
